summary: Frontend-focused regression run completed for build23 signing fix. Verified root/frontend config parity, confirmed Stripe native plugin removal in both app.json files, validated introspection entitlements={}, generated fresh scratch iOS projects outside repo, and passed mobile smoke navigation at 390x844 without functional errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings observed: deprecated textShadow*/shadow* style props on web preview; non-blocking for this signing fix.

action_items: User/main agent must rerun remote EAS signed archive for build23 and verify Xcode/Fastlane no longer requests Apple Pay capability.
Run TestFlight install/launch verification on physical iOS/iPadOS devices; this Linux run cannot verify signed IPA runtime.
Optional product follow-up: remove or relabel decorative Apple Pay badge in checkout UI unless true Apple Pay is implemented and provisioned.
critical_code_review_comments: Root and frontend duplicated projects remain a drift risk; parity is currently good but needs consolidation planning.
Checkout UI still visually shows an Apple Pay badge while native Apple Pay is not implemented/provisioned, which can confuse release/signing expectations.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (scope checks passed: 7/7 pytest + smoke flow pass)

context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth submission, no checkout route with real booking, and no backend/payment mutation were performed. Fresh scratch prebuilds were generated only under /tmp/wy_scratch_root_b23_fresh and /tmp/wy_scratch_front_b23_fresh. Entitlements are empty dict in introspection and generated plist files, Info.plist retains UIAppFonts TraditionalArabic-Regular.ttf and UIApplicationSceneManifest with EXExpoAppSceneDelegate, and root/frontend generated iOS artifacts are byte-identical for entitlements/Info.plist/AppDelegate.
rca_of_issue: Build failure a1134533-3fd6-4f32-a7df-a2cd4577abad was a signing entitlement mismatch: provisioning profile lacked Apple Pay capabilities while previous config/plugin path introduced Apple Pay expectations. Removing only the unused Stripe native config plugin from both app.json removes entitlement pressure in generated configs (entitlements remain {}), while keeping web card checkout unchanged. Remote signed archive verification is still required.
